ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and lower margins; estimated ratio of 15% high-intensity to 85% low-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-contrast white blobs are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and along the distal trailing edges. Two isolated, high-intensity circular points are positioned approximately equidistant from the median notch on the central dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50-55 degrees; depth occupies roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks is more pronounced on the left lobe margin compared to the right; irregular jaggedness visible at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a slight proximal concavity near the notch transitioning to a broad convex curve toward the acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; two isolated white circular points located on the inner surface near the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct, unaligned diagonal linear disruption (rake mark) extending from the lower-center of the left lobe toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips; prominent diagonal linear scar on the left lobe; two focal circular scars near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible vertical median ridge/line extending from the base of the notch downwards toward the peduncle connection.
